reason: The only reason I'd try a run-to-earn app is if the points are worth something, and this one says straight out that SUP can't be turned into cash. Plus I mostly run on a treadmill after work, so a GPS route app and an outdoor crew start don't fit how I actually run.
objection: Points that can't be cashed out are just a game score with extra steps. Fixing up virtual shoes for points nobody can spend sounds like STEPN without even the payout, so why spend my time on it?
would_change_my_mind: If the points could be traded for something real I'd actually use, like gift cards, gym or race-entry discounts, or running gear, and it counted my treadmill runs fairly.
